verification.spec: Import the PPO on-policy actor loss function from the implementation. Construct synthetic tensors for log-probabilities of current policy and old policy, advantages, and clipping epsilon. Compute the loss and verify: (1) the ratio r_t = exp(log_pi_new - log_pi_old) is used; (2) the loss equals E[min(r_t * A, clip(r_t, 1-eps, 1+eps) * A)] with clipping epsilon matching config (0.1 or 0.2); (3) when new policy equals old, gradient is proportional to advantage; (4) when r_t is outside [1-eps, 1+eps] and would increase loss, clipping is active. Compare against a numpy reference implementation of Eq. 2.

verification.spec: Locate the value-target computation for on-policy critic updates. Construct a synthetic rollout of at least 4 steps with known rewards r_t, r_{t+1}, r_{t+2}, and value estimate V(s_{t+3}). Verify the computed target equals sum_{k=t}^{t+2} gamma^{k-t} * r_k + gamma^3 * V(s_{t+3}) with n=3. Test with gamma=0.99 and confirm numerical match to a hand-computed reference.
